# Persona Generator

> Protocol-first Markdown for generating academically bounded fictional personas on demand for multi-agent rehearsal.

Persona Generator is for fictional, low-stakes advisory work. It stores persona-generation grammar, not a static persona catalog. `llms.txt` is provided as an experimental navigation aid and does not guarantee crawler or model support.

## Do Not Use For

Real-person profiling, diagnosis, psychometric scoring, sensitive-attribute inference, hiring, surveillance, legal, medical, credit, insurance, educational placement, or autonomous decisions.
